maxParticipants.description: RFC 0101. OPTIONAL host ceiling on the size of the `conversation.opened.participants` roster. A multi-party council has at least 2 participants. When advertised, the host MUST reject a `conversation.opened` whose `participants` array exceeds this count. Absent ⇒ the host does not bound the roster size on the wire.
